changelog:
- Initial release of EU Trade Analytics skill.
- Query over 28 million Eurostat COMEXT bilateral trade records (27 EU member states, 1988–2025).
- Supports monthly data on import/export flows, HS2–CN8 product codes, prices, seasonality, and market concentration (HHI).
- Includes endpoints for trade overview, timeline, top partners, price per tonne, seasonality, and concentration.
- Free and paid tiers available for analytics queries.
summary: Query 28M+ Eurostat COMEXT trade records — 27 EU countries, bilateral flows, HS2-CN8 codes, 1988-2025
